title: Word Association Bridge · Pair relay
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Word Association Bridge · Pair relay with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose two unrelated everyday words. The lead supplies one word that connects both and explains the connection. The other players can understand both connections. Form pairs. On each pair’s turn, both people make separate attempts with fresh challenges, helping only their partner. The pair earns one point only if both succeed. Each pair has two turns. Highest score wins.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4, 6 or 8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Word Association Bridge, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The other players can understand both connections.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
recall.why: The other players can understand both connections.
